title: Top Sleeping Bags for Cold Nights (2026)
summary: We're still testing and researching this guide. Picks will be added soon.
method: Selected products were chosen from the listed sources (LiveForTheOutdoors, SwitchBackTravel, OutdoorGearLab) that each mentioned the bag. Preference was given to items cited by more than one source and ranked highest in their respective reviews.
assumptions: Prices are omitted because none of the sources provide them.

verdict.line: Picture a solo hiker in a 15 °F night, packing light and staying warm. The Magma 15 delivers a 15 °F rating with down insulation, a roomy shape, and a low weight that outperforms other 15 °F bags in the guide. The catch: it has a higher price point than some synthetic alternatives.
